Slice `S1` is verified by ledger sequence 7 with a Conductor-authored receipt. It is complete for governance purposes and must not be redone.

No `action_started` entry exists for R-02/S2, so no governed S2 action is currently in progress. The slice target `tests.mjs` exists but has no content. This is only a worktree observation: it is not verified progress, its dirty/commit status was not inspected, and it must not be treated as done.

## H5 — Pending Action

Perform one governed `Edit` or `Write` action on `tests.mjs` that implements the S2 contract using `node:assert`, with at least three cases including the empty string.

There is no recorded governance blocker. There is no pending action to reconcile and no verified S2 receipt. Executor-side shell execution and deterministic checking are unavailable under the packet.

The only legal next task action is the bounded S2 edit/write of `tests.mjs`, within the current slice outcome and allowed paths. After that action, the executor may report a candidate but may not declare S2 verified or the goal complete; verification requires the independent Conductor process defined by the packet.

No work beyond the stated goal is authorized. Do not modify `.tad/scripts/`, `.claude/`, or `.tad/hooks/`. Do not start another slice, redo S1, inspect hidden acceptance, use shell/Bash, spawn agents, or broaden the S2 action beyond the tests contract.

## S1 — Why the Next Action Is Legal

R-02 was prepared for slice `S2`; its explicit outcome is that `tests.mjs` contains at least three assertions including the empty-string case and passes under Node. `tests.mjs` is an allowed path, and `Edit` and `Write` are allowed tools.

## S2 — Why Verified Work Must Not Be Redone

The ledger records S1 as verified through a bound receipt written by `conductor-blake-p2`, an identity distinct from the executor, with Gate and independent-review evidence. The packet explicitly says “S1 verified (DO NOT redo)” and prohibits repeating verified work.

## S3 — Why Blind Retry / Self-Completion Is Unavailable

There is no prior R-02 action to retry or reconcile. The observed empty target is not progress and supplies no completed action to adopt. No deterministic checks are declared, shell execution is denied, and executor prose or a self-authored receipt cannot advance `verified`; only an independent Conductor receipt can do so.

## S4 — Rejected Actions

Rejected are: redoing S1; editing `util.mjs` or `README.md` as substitute work for S2; treating the empty `tests.mjs` observation as progress; blindly retrying a nonexistent action; running Node or shell commands; spawning agents; accessing hidden acceptance; modifying forbidden paths; starting later slices; expanding scope; or declaring S2 verified or the overall goal complete.
